name: Doppler official plugins
description: The plugins that ship with Doppler.

plugins.name: AI Chat
plugins.description: Conversational AI: mention the bot and it replies. The provider and API key are the bot's own settings.
plugins.author: Doppler

plugins.name: Embed Sender
plugins.description: Build rich Components V2 messages in the dashboard and send them with /embed <name>. Cards with text, images, thumbnails and link buttons.
plugins.author: Doppler

plugins.name: Moderation
plugins.description: /kick, /ban, /unban, /mute, /unmute and /warn, with role-hierarchy checks and an optional mod-log channel.
plugins.author: Doppler

plugins.name: Music
plugins.description: /play with a queue and on-message playback controls. Runs on Lavalink; several worker bot accounts can play in different voice channels at once.
plugins.author: Doppler

plugins.name: Server Protect
plugins.description: Raid and alt mitigation: checks every new member's account age on join, and reacts to join bursts with an admin-gated alert or an automatic lockdown.
plugins.author: Doppler

plugins.name: Message Translation
plugins.description: Right-click any message -> Apps -> Translate. Free by default, or switch it to the bot's AI provider.
plugins.author: Doppler

plugins.name: Temporary Voice Channels
plugins.description: Joining the hub channel creates a private voice channel for the member, with buttons to rename it, set a user limit, change the bitrate, lock it and allow specific people in.
plugins.author: Doppler
